tasks.title: Repository discovery and baseline review
validation: Inspect existing instructions, manifests, source, tests, and documentation.
Confirm unrelated worktree changes are preserved.
Capture scope, constraints, and failure cases before drafting artifacts.

tasks.title: Draft reviewable specification
validation: Ensure SPEC.md contains unique REQ-XXX entries.
Each requirement includes acceptance scenarios.
Approval semantics and fingerprint requirements are explicit.

tasks.title: Draft implementation plan
validation: Verify PLAN.md contains architecture, execution steps, requirement mapping, and validation strategy.
Confirm the plan is consistent with the trusted-target and verification model.

tasks.title: Draft task inventory and dependency graph
validation: Ensure TASKS.json includes unique IDs, dependency references, statuses, and validation instructions.
Detect duplicate task IDs, invalid fields, and missing requirement references.

tasks.title: Human review and approval gate
validation: A human must explicitly review SPEC.md, PLAN.md, and TASKS.json.
Approval must be recorded via the CLI approval workflow, not by informal acceptance.

tasks.title: Create canonical SDD workflow documentation
validation: Ensure SDD-WORKFLOW.md describes Specify → Clarify → Plan → Tasks → Implement → Verify.
Classify claims as Observed, Inferred, Proposed, or Unverified.

tasks.title: Create Copilot customization assets and IDE guidance
validation: Check `.github/` files exist with expected names and shared instructions.
Verify local plain-language fallback behavior is documented for IDEs without slash prompts.

tasks.title: Implement artifact validation rules and approval fingerprint checks
validation: Reject missing or malformed artifacts.
Reject unresolved clarification markers, missing sections, duplicate requirement IDs, and empty requirements.
Invalidate approvals when relevant content changes.

tasks.title: Implement CLI and local API
validation: Verify `check`, `approve`, `verify`, and `serve` commands exist and return expected exit codes.
Confirm `/`, `/api/sdd/status`, and `/api/sdd/verify` are served on loopback.

tasks.title: Implement trusted-target verification engine
validation: Check preflight validation for artifacts, approvals, wrapper files, source/tests, and Gradle tasks.
Confirm execution order is Checkstyle → tests → JaCoCo.
Reject missing, skipped, malformed, or insufficient evidence.

tasks.title: Implement local dashboard and historical evidence display
validation: Render truthful states for NOT_RUN, BLOCKED, RUNNING, PASSED, and FAILED.
Display logs as plain text and clearly mark historical results as non-live evidence.

tasks.title: Add bootstrap, templates, and Java example fixture
validation: Confirm bootstrap is idempotent and does not overwrite instructions or duplicate a server.
Verify Java 21 example is isolated, realistic, and separate from Python tooling.

tasks.title: Add deterministic tests and CI
validation: Run targeted tests for invalidation, traceability, dependency cycles, subprocess failures, concurrency, and dashboard behavior.
Verify CI uses public tooling without private infrastructure.

tasks.title: Write user-facing guides and troubleshooting docs
validation: Ensure README.md and USER-GUIDE.md cover installation, setup, safe adoption, workflow, console, dashboard, Java example, failing tests, troubleshooting, and trust limitations.

tasks.title: Phase 3 verification and evidence reporting
validation: Run the smallest relevant tests first, then broader checks if necessary.
Summarize commands, outcomes, coverage, blocked checks, and any unverified IDE behavior honestly.
